title: Construct Tree from Preorder and Inorder - Solution
intuition: Given two integer arrays preorder and inorder where preorder is the preorder traversal of a binary tree and inorder is the inorder traversal of the same tree, construct and return the binary tree.
step_by_step_explanation: Iterate through elements and apply logic accordingly.
common_mistakes: First element in preorder is always root. Find root in inorder to split left/right subtrees.
